model: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=300, random_state=42) on raw 8 features, 80/20 stratified split
notes: Trained on 691 rows and tested on 173. The original data.csv had 57 exact duplicate rows that I accidentally deleted before splitting (no backup), so the model uses 864 rows; zeros in glucose/blood_pressure/skin_thickness/insulin/bmi were left as-is.
